plugins.name: assumption-audit
plugins.description: Surface hidden assumptions in a feature, decision, or plan. Exposes what you're taking for granted so you can validate before committing.

plugins.name: pm-coach
plugins.description: Two complementary PM thinking tools: challenge feature prioritization with a structured framework, or enter a conversational coaching mode to sharpen your thinking.

plugins.name: spec-crafting
plugins.description: Full specification toolkit — PRD writing, EPIC decomposition, user story writing, acceptance criteria, and Jira push in one plugin.

plugins.name: design-system-as-text
plugins.description: A set of skills that represents your Figma design system as structured markdown and CSS files — making it easy for LLMs to understand and apply your design system when building UI.

plugins.name: api-design
plugins.description: Design a well-structured API from a desired outcome. Produces OpenAPI specifications, usage examples, and a plain-language section for non-technical stakeholders.
